title: SHARP NFL Week 7 Bets: 49ers-Falcons, Bucs-Panthers, Rams-Raiders, Packers-Lions, Chiefs-Seahawks
transcript_summary: Chad Millman and Simon Hunter break down the NFL Week 7 betting board on 'Sharp or Square'. They analyze key sharp movements, contest strategies, underdog/favorites moneyline parlays, and best bets for games including 49ers-Falcons, Bucs-Panthers, Rams-Raiders, Packers-Lions, and Chiefs-Seahawks.

speaker_segments.speaker: Chad Millman
speaker_segments.text: Welcome to Sharp or Square presented by Polymarket, part of The Volume Podcast Network. I'm Chad Millman, joined as always by Simon Hunter.

speaker_segments.speaker: Simon Hunter
speaker_segments.text: Chad, how are we doing?

speaker_segments.speaker: Chad Millman
speaker_segments.text: Brother, I apologize for my orange complexion and New York studio background. This is our Thursday Week 7 NFL show with Sharp Calls, Brass Balls, and Contest picks.

speaker_segments.speaker: Simon Hunter
speaker_segments.text: As soon as we talked about futures, people were asking if it's time to capture teams on the rise like Green Bay or Minnesota in the NFC.

speaker_segments.speaker: Simon Hunter
speaker_segments.text: Looking at exact Super Bowl matchups, Chiefs to beat Packers is 100 to 1 and Packers to beat Chiefs is 110 to 1. In player futures, Golden is 40 to 1 to lead in receiving, and Kevin O'Connell is +650 to win Coach of the Year.

speaker_segments.speaker: Chad Millman
speaker_segments.text: Green Bay has been the pivot point in these futures conversations. Let's move into our weekly Sharp Calls segment.

speaker_segments.speaker: Audio Montage
speaker_segments.text: [Movie clips montage for Sharp Calls]

speaker_segments.speaker: Simon Hunter
speaker_segments.text: Sharp calls loved Falcons +3.5, Bucs +3.5, Dolphins/Jets, Cincy line flip, Green Bay +3 vs Detroit, Denver, Tennessee, and Seattle vs Kansas City.

speaker_segments.speaker: Chad Millman
speaker_segments.text: Let's start with Giants at Texans, where line moved from 9.5 to 10.5 after McCarthy was named starter.

speaker_segments.speaker: Simon Hunter
speaker_segments.text: Be careful chasing line moves late, but respect the sharp money coming in on Houston against McCarthy and Minnesota's travel return from London.

speaker_segments.speaker: Chad Millman
speaker_segments.text: San Francisco at Atlanta moved down through 3 to Atlanta +2.5. Pros are on Atlanta while public is on Niners.

speaker_segments.speaker: Simon Hunter
speaker_segments.text: I wouldn't take Falcons below +3, but the matchup favors Atlanta with Mike Evans out for San Francisco impacting third downs.

speaker_segments.speaker: Chad Millman
speaker_segments.text: Tampa Bay at Carolina is Bucs +3. We loved Carolina earlier, but backing Bryce Young as a field-goal favorite is tough.

speaker_segments.speaker: Simon Hunter
speaker_segments.text: Keep it simple, don't ask Bryce Young to blow out divisional opponents. Tampa Bay +3 or +3.5 after a loss is a great situational spot.

speaker_segments.speaker: Chad Millman
speaker_segments.text: Cleveland at Tennessee has Browns -1.5 road favorites. Huge discrepancy between tickets and money on Tennessee.

speaker_segments.speaker: Simon Hunter
speaker_segments.text: Browns choke in this exact spot 80% of the time after big divisional wins. Plus, off-field drama around Tennessee adds uncertainty.

speaker_segments.speaker: Chad Millman
speaker_segments.text: Let's be grown-ups and avoid forcing Tennessee into our contest picks.

speaker_segments.speaker: Simon Hunter
speaker_segments.text: Agreed, let's look at the Polymarket Brass Balls Trade of the Week: Miami Dolphins +4.5 against the New York Jets.

speaker_segments.speaker: Simon Hunter
speaker_segments.text: Division underdog with over 4 points in a low-scoring divisional matchup. Jets are overrated by back-to-back covers.

speaker_segments.speaker: Chad Millman
speaker_segments.text: Sign up on Polymarket with code SHARP for a $25 bonus. Next up, Colts at Vikings (-6.5).

speaker_segments.speaker: Simon Hunter
speaker_segments.text: Flores' defense gives huge problems to quarterbacks like Daniel Jones unless Jonathan Taylor runs for 150+ yards.

speaker_segments.speaker: Chad Millman
speaker_segments.text: Broncos at Cardinals (-4.5). Bo Nix struggles on the road while Cardinals have been competitive.

speaker_segments.speaker: Simon Hunter
speaker_segments.text: Sharps are on Denver here viewing it as a get-right spot against Arizona's weak defense.

speaker_segments.speaker: Chad Millman
speaker_segments.text: Packers at Lions (-3). Line touched -3.5. Green Bay's defense looked elite against Dallas, but Detroit is well-rested off a bye.

speaker_segments.speaker: Simon Hunter
speaker_segments.text: Detroit's defense gives up points to everyone. If line is -3 or lower, I lean Lions, but Packers +3.5 is sharp value.

speaker_segments.speaker: Simon Hunter
speaker_segments.text: Rams at Raiders line dropped from -4.5 to -3.5. Rams are depleted with injuries on defense and along the line.

speaker_segments.speaker: Chad Millman
speaker_segments.text: Chiefs at Seahawks (-2.5). Patrick Mahomes is 10-3 ATS as a dog in his career.

speaker_segments.speaker: Chad Millman
speaker_segments.text: Discord Group Bet of the week: Chiefs +8.5 and Vikings -0.5 teaser.

speaker_segments.speaker: Simon Hunter
speaker_segments.text: Underdog ML Parlay: Falcons, Bucs, Chiefs, Raiders, Dolphins. Favorites ML Parlay: Bengals, Broncos, Lions.

speaker_segments.speaker: Simon Hunter
speaker_segments.text: My biggest bets this week are Falcons +3.5 and Bucs +3.5 based on line value.

speaker_segments.speaker: Chad Millman
speaker_segments.text: In Sharp vs. Square, I'll take Detroit -3 and Simon takes Denver -4. Survivor pick is Minnesota.

speaker_segments.speaker: Chad Millman
speaker_segments.text: Subscribe to the show, rate 5 stars, see you live Sunday at 11am Eastern!
